title: Explorer pill
responsibility: Shows a short inline label, such as a state or a count, in the explorer pill style.

inputs.name: Pill.as
inputs.description: Selects the tag that hx-element renders: 'span' by default, or 'li' for a list-item container. The type accepts only these two literal values.

inputs.name: Pill.variant
inputs.description: Selects one existing visual treatment: 'explorer' (the default) gives ex-pill, 'compact' gives pill, and 'chip' gives chip. Any other defined value also gets the chip class, because chip is the final fallback of the class selection.

inputs.name: Pill.tone
inputs.description: Extra class names added after the variant class, as one string that may hold several space-separated names. It defaults to an empty string, and an empty value adds no class because falsy entries are removed before the classes are joined.

inputs.name: Pill.state
inputs.description: Styling state written to the data-state attribute of the rendered element; the type accepts any string. It defaults to JavaScript undefined, so data-state is omitted when no state is given.

inputs.name: Pill.role
inputs.description: Semantic role written to the role attribute of the rendered element; the type accepts only 'img' or 'status'. It defaults to JavaScript undefined, so role is omitted when no role is given.

inputs.name: Pill.label
inputs.description: Accessible name written to the aria-label attribute of the rendered element; the type accepts any string. It defaults to JavaScript undefined, so aria-label is omitted when no label is given.

inputs.name: Pill.title
inputs.description: Native tooltip text written to the title attribute of the rendered element; the type accepts any string. It defaults to JavaScript undefined, so title is omitted when no title is given.
examples: Open reports in the last 7 days

inputs.name: Pill.children
inputs.description: Required caller-owned content rendered inside the element with {@render children()}. The component has no try or catch around that call, so an error thrown while the snippet renders propagates to the owner.

outputs.name: Pill
outputs.description: Markup for one hx-element whose tag is set by as and whose class is the variant class plus tone. The data-state, role, aria-label and title attributes are applied only when their inputs are given, and the children snippet is rendered inside the element.

errors.name: Content rendering error
errors.description: Pill has no try or catch around the children snippet, so an error thrown while that snippet renders propagates to the owner. The Pill script contains no throw statement of its own.
